title: Export and document text helpers
acceptance_criterion: src/index.js exports slugify, truncate, and wordCount, and README documents each helper and its callable signature.
deterministic_validity_check: node --input-type=module -e "import { slugify, truncate, wordCount } from './src/index.js'; if (slugify('A B') !== 'a-b' || truncate('hello', 4) !== 'h...' || wordCount('a b') !== 2) throw new Error('public exports failed')"
required_tests: named review check: README.md documents slugify(text), truncate(text, max), and wordCount(text)
patch_requirements: Modify src/index.js to re-export all three new helper modules while preserving the existing capitalize export.
Modify README.md to document all three helpers with their names and parameters.
Do not alter package.json or capitalize behavior.
